decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical multiplex channel definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND sources include mult.inc.
DOS DIRCALL uses multNET in emitted instructions; its previously compared 521-byte contribution matches target MSDOS.SYS (review 055).
BIOS MSLOAD uses multMULT and multMULTRPLTOM; the prior 1446-byte comparison differed only in the separately tracked minor-version byte (review 019).
limitations: Selected comparisons support exercised channel constants, not every listed external service or optional configuration. Final links and whole-file identity remain unverified.
